videos.title: No more paid AI meeting note takers | AnythingLLM Desktop
videos.description:
We just made every paid AI meeting note-taking tool irrelevant. AnythingLLM is the productivity tool AI has promised you, but without any cloud costs, rate limits, or usage caps.

There is no legitimate reason to send all of your personal and private conversations to a third party for a simple summary.  Now, with AnythingLLM Desktop v1.10.0, we ship a fully on-device meeting assistant.

*Features*
➔ Transcription (multiple languages)
➔ Speaker Identification
➔ Joined meeting notifications
➔ Custom summaries & templates
➔ Agent actions items
➔ Chat with transcript
➔ Search across all meetings by keyword or semantically.
➔ Upload and process any existing audio or media file with sound

*all on device with no data going to a cloud!* Seriously.

Did you know that a 3-hour podcast has less than 16K tokens of spoken text? That is light work for any small to mid-range LLM on even halfway decent hardware. Combine that with all the already existing features of AnythingLLM, and now you can stop paying for cloud-based solutions for such a simple task.

In a world of pay-per-token LLMs you probably have looked everywhere to get your Local or Cloud-hosted LLM model to act like an AI assistant on your website - well now with AnythingLLM it is free and open source!

Today, we are going to create an AI chatbot for our website trained on the data from our own website! All of this is built into the AnythingLLM cloud or our self-hosted version you can run anywhere. 

The embed takes minutes to set up and is a single HTML snippet you can embed into your website and get a powerful chatbot to handle customer questions.

With AnythingLLM, you can now publish smarter chatbots using any LLM trained on your custom documents and show them on any webpage will all the controls and tools you need to make sure the questions are on topic and costs are controlled!

AnythingLLM supports link-scraping, PDFs, text documents, and so much more then you can throw at it!
